ท้องทุ่งนา (Thai rice field): A wide rice paddy photographed at eye level, with ripening rice in yellow-green and golden tones filling the entire lower half of the frame. Across the middle ground runs a long, narrow walkway raised on thin wooden posts, stretching from the centre to the right edge, with simple post railings. On the walkway, right of centre, stands one small open hut with a brown thatched roof. Behind the field is a line of mixed trees and bushes, including a clump of tall bamboo at left and a small white roof partly hidden among trees at left (building type unclear). The background is a large forest-covered mountain in dense green, with a small grassy clearing on its slope at right. The sky is hazy and nearly white. Daylight with soft, diffuse light; exact time of day unclear. No people or animals visible.
